official_index: NOAA CPC Oceanic Niño Index (ONI) / current RONI guidance
legacy_definition: three-month running mean of Niño 3.4 SST anomalies
threshold_note: NOAA documents warm/cold periods with a +/-0.5 C threshold; use the index version and baseline stated by NOAA for the publication date.
interpretation_rule: Use the join to compare timing and spatial response; do not claim causation from correlation alone.
